entities.name: Francisco Javier González de Castejón y Elío
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francisco Javier González de Castejón y Elío, 8th Marquis of Vadillo was a Spanish lawyer and politician who served as minister of Justice during the regency of Maria Christina of Austria, and served as minister of Development and minister of the Interior during the reign of Alfonso XIII. He also served as the Solicitor General of Spain.
